thread:
Maya R.: FYI, I pushed int4-v2 into staging for a micro bring-up. Quick summary: latency -18% median, cost -27%, but longform ROUGE drops ~4.8% on our docs suite (mostly >1024 tokens).
Jeff H.: nice perf delta. where are the regressions concentrated? specific prompt families?
Maya R.: mostly 'summarize-changelog' and 'legal-extract' slices. short Q/A looks fine. sample: `> expected 0.87 rouge, got 0.83` on ~1.4k tokens prompts.
Anika S.: can you paste the slice metrics and eval diff? want to see per-token vs per-output effect.
Maya R.: pasted below:
```
slice: summarize-changelog  n=240  rouge-L delta -6.2%  median latency -20ms
slice: legal-extract      n=180  rouge-L delta -5.1%  median latency -22ms
slice: support-thread     n=400  rouge-L delta -0.9%  median latency -18ms
overall                 n=1200  rouge-L delta -4.8%  median latency -19ms
```
Samir K.: that's larger than our usual tolerance. Current canary gate: any delta > 3% on QoR triggers hold.
Maya R.: right. I wanted to propose a phased rollout config that weighs latency wins against fidelity loss for longcontexts. idea: if latency gain > 15% and cost >20% we allow up to 6% drop on longform but require shadow-eval A/B on 5k requests in staging.
Jeff H.: ugh, that feels risky. Might be okay for non-critical slices but legal-extract can't tolerate that. We should do slice-aware guards, not a global allowance.
Anika S.: agree. propose patch:
```
promote_rules:
  - if slice in [legal-extract, financial-summary]: max_qor_drop: 1.5%
  - elif tokens > 1024: max_qor_drop: 6%  require_shadow_samples: 5k
  - else: max_qor_drop: 3%
  - auto-fallback: if live_qor_drop > 2% on any critical slice -> immediate rollback
```
Samir K.: add hysteresis: only trigger rollback after sustained signal over 30m window or >30% of sampled requests failing eval in the window. prevents flapping.
Maya R.: good call. also want to track qualitative failure modes (e.g., hallucination increase). we can attach a simple classifier check on hallucination tokens and alert if >0.5% absolute increase.
Jeff H.: ops-bot: can you run a quick shadow A/B with 10% traffic split on staging (int4-v2) against baseline for the next 48h and capture slice metrics + hallucination classifier? tag results to this thread.
ops-bot: scheduled shadow run: start=1748503450  split=10%  duration=48h  owner=@ops-bot  id=run-3471 :gear:
Maya R.: thanks. one more config suggestion: during live canary, route requests >2048 tokens to baseline only (coldpath safety). we keep short to int4. reduces exposure.
Anika S.: 👍 prefer explicit coldpath routing. add to rollout config.
Samir K.: Also add automatic rollback policy snippet to deploy-bot so it can cut traffic and revert model within 60s of meeting rollback criteria.
deploy-bot: rollback hook installed. policy id: rbk-2026-int4v2. rollback window: 60s, min-samples: 200, sustained-window: 30m.
Jeff H.: once shadow run finishes, we'll meet to interpret the A/B slices. If legal-extract passes at 1.5% threshold and hallucination delta <0.3% we can consider a small phased promote (5% -> 25% -> 50%).
Maya R.: noted. I'll post the shadow run artifacts and a small sample corpus by EOD. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Anika S.: will prep dashboard widgets for slice gating and ops alerts.
Samir K.: I'll add logs for quick postmortem if rollback triggers.
Maya R.: tagging follow-ups: @Anika S., @Samir K., @Jeff H. - please ack when dashboards + rollback hooks are in place.
Jeff H.: ack
Anika S.: ack
Samir K.: ack
